description: This file defines the EmployeeSearchFilterParams class, which extends a base FilterParams class and includes properties and methods for filtering employee search results in an HRM system. It also uses traits and constants to specify allowed search fields and options, and handles validation for certain parameters.

classes.name: EmployeeSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object class that encapsulates search filtering parameters for employee queries, including filtering by employee name, ID, status, title, and organizational subunit, with validation and predefined allowed values.

methods.name: getIncludeEmployees
methods.description: Returns the value of the includeEmployees property, which indicates whether to include only current, only past, or both current and past employees.

methods.name: setIncludeEmployees
methods.description: Sets the includeEmployees property, validating that the value is one of the allowed options mapped in INCLUDE_EMPLOYEES_MAP.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name filter parameter.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Assigns a value to the name filter parameter.

methods.name: getNameOrId
methods.description: Returns the nameOrId filter parameter.

methods.name: setNameOrId
methods.description: Sets the nameOrId filter parameter.

methods.name: getEmployeeNumbers
methods.description: Retrieves the array of employee numbers used for filtering.

methods.name: setEmployeeNumbers
methods.description: Sets the employeeNumbers filter parameter.

methods.name: getEmployeeId
methods.description: Returns the employee ID filter parameter.

methods.name: setEmployeeId
methods.description: Sets the employee ID filter parameter.

methods.name: getEmpStatusId
methods.description: Returns the employment status ID filter.

methods.name: setEmpStatusId
methods.description: Sets the employment status ID filter.

methods.name: getJobTitleId
methods.description: Returns the job title ID filter.

methods.name: setJobTitleId
methods.description: Sets the job title ID filter.

methods.name: getSubunitId
methods.description: Returns the subunit ID filter.

methods.name: setSubunitId
methods.description: Sets the subunit ID filter.

methods.name: getSupervisorEmpNumbers
methods.description: Retrieves supervisor employee numbers filter.

methods.name: setSupervisorEmpNumbers
methods.description: Sets supervisor employee numbers filter.

methods.name: getLocationId
methods.description: Returns the location ID filter.

methods.name: setLocationId
methods.description: Sets the location ID filter.
